visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a dark green knit top and light grey pants, is seated on a white fabric sofa. A hand enters the frame from the bottom left, holding a large shallow cardboard box. Inside the box are several blue 1000 TWD bills and one red 100 TWD bill. The woman holds a smartphone in her left hand and looks at the box with interest. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (2) The box is shaken rapidly by the hand, causing the bills to fly and bounce within the cardboard frame. The woman laughs, her mouth open and eyes crinkling, as she reaches her right hand into the box. She is actively trying to grab a moving bill. The background remains the white sofa and a plain wall. (3) The woman holds up a single red 100 TWD bill, her expression shifting from excitement to a mock-disappointed pout. A yellow and white sponge is then placed into her hand from off-screen. She looks down at the sponge, accepting her fate.
